name: everything-file-search
title: Everything Search
description: Fast local file search powered by Everything: filter by file type, sort by name/path/size/date, preview text and images in the detail panel.
author: shaunwuu

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Files with Everything
commands.subtitle: File Search
commands.description: Search local files with Everything, with type filters, sorting and preview

commands.name: manage-types
commands.title: Configure File Types
commands.subtitle: Everything Search
commands.description: Add, edit and remove custom file type filters

preferences.name: host
preferences.title: Everything HTTP Host
preferences.description: Address of the Everything HTTP server (localhost only by default)

preferences.name: port
preferences.title: Everything HTTP Port
preferences.description: Defaults to 8085. The extension can enable the HTTP server for you if it's off

preferences.name: maxResults
preferences.title: Page Size
preferences.description: Number of results fetched per page

preferences.name: showFolder
preferences.title: Type: Folders
preferences.description: Show the Folders filter in the type dropdown
preferences.label: Folders

preferences.name: showDoc
preferences.title: Type: Documents
preferences.description: Show the Documents filter (doc, docx, pdf, txt, md…)
preferences.label: Documents

preferences.name: showImage
preferences.title: Type: Images
preferences.description: Show the Images filter (jpg, png, gif, webp, svg…)
preferences.label: Images

preferences.name: showVideo
preferences.title: Type: Videos
preferences.description: Show the Videos filter (mp4, mkv, avi, mov…)
preferences.label: Videos

preferences.name: showAudio
preferences.title: Type: Audio
preferences.description: Show the Audio filter (mp3, flac, wav, aac…)
preferences.label: Audio

preferences.name: showArchive
preferences.title: Type: Archives
preferences.description: Show the Archives filter (zip, rar, 7z, tar, iso…)
preferences.label: Archives

preferences.name: showApp
preferences.title: Type: Apps
preferences.description: Show the Apps filter (exe, msi, bat, ps1…)
preferences.label: Apps

preferences.name: showCode
preferences.title: Type: Code
preferences.description: Show the Code filter (ts, js, py, java, json…)
preferences.label: Code

preferences.name: showFont
preferences.title: Type: Fonts
preferences.description: Show the Fonts filter (ttf, otf, woff, woff2…)
preferences.label: Fonts

scripts.build:raycast: ray build -o ./dist && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of fs.readdirSync('dist').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')))fs.copyFileSync('dist/'+f,f)"
